routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area

notes: REQ-6.1 is a sidebar styling pass, not a new nav item or layout change. The sidebar drawer (opened via the Main menu button, REQ-1.1) already contains all five required navigation entries: the nav items Notes/Archive/Trash, the Edit labels entry, and the Reminders label filter (REQ-2.7.3, a real button whose accessible name is exactly 'Reminders'). The acceptance test opens the sidebar then asserts /notes/i, /reminders/i, /edit labels/i, /archive/i, /trash/i are visible - satisfied by the existing DOM. Two constraints forbid structural changes: (1) do NOT add a 'Reminders' nav-item button - REQ-2.7.6.3 clicks 'Reminders' and must hit the label-filter button (DOM-first resolution would pick a nav item and show the reminders-by-date view, hiding 'Call dentist existing' which has reminder:null and label ['Reminders']); (2) the sidebar must stay closed by default - REQ-2.5.x archive flows click /archive/i on note cards while the drawer is closed, so an always-open sidebar would hijack those clicks. Implementation: unify the item base style (.nav-item, .label-filter-item, .edit-labels-item) into one shared rule - fixed 18px icon column (flex: 0 0 18px), consistent gap/padding/radius, font-family: inherit, one shared hover state (--hover), one shared selected-item highlight (#feefc3 + medium weight for .active), and a shared :focus-visible outline. No route, data, or JS behavior changes.
